earth_1g_validation.findings: Accurate separation between quiet seated rest and active movement under standard 1-g Earth gravity.

spaceflight_microgravity_0g_validation.locomotion_magnitude: Variable (0.1g to 0.8g depending on exercise device tethering)
spaceflight_microgravity_0g_validation.defect_analysis: The condition `acc_mag <= 1.05 and acc_std <= 0.04` will evaluate to TRUE during free-floating microgravity rest, but will also trigger false positive rest classifications when translation occurs without torso accelerometer registration. Furthermore, `acc_mag > 1.15` will fail to detect high-intensity zero-g exercise unless tether strain registers as gravitational normal.

population_hardcoding_evaluation.finding: Population resting HR ceiling (hr <= 78.0 bpm) violates personalization invariants.
population_hardcoding_evaluation.impact: Athletes with resting tachycardia (e.g. post-EVA dehydration) will be rejected from REST context even while sleeping, defaulting to NOMINAL_OPERATIONAL.
population_hardcoding_evaluation.recommendation: Use personal percentile-based context inference (e.g. HR < P25 of personal history) rather than static 78.0 bpm.
